subject: DISPLAY statement
notes: IMPLEMENTED + DOCUMENTED (kb/Work PB164, PB244; docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-57): the GR7 format is the A.1 item 57 determination - members' images in declaration order, dynamic members at CURRENT extent, fixed members by the ONE record-image member law, following the 15.50.4 r7 LENGTH sum in character positions, so FUNCTION LENGTH(G) equals the displayed width. EVERY shape renders, none is refused: an OCCURS DEPENDING table beside a dynamic member at its current count (13.18.38.4 GR8); a table whose ELEMENTS are variable-length groups, OCCURS DEPENDING or dynamic-capacity, each occurrence at its own current extent; and all of it in a CELL-BACKED group (an EXTERNAL or ADDRESS-OF-taken record) as in a declared one - the cell composes each element with the element's own window shape (CellGroupShape) and an OCCURS DEPENDING table's occurrences beyond the count drop their components with their fixed run (OdoTail.Comps). The golden pb244_vlg_display_cell_element_tables is the cell-backed twin of pb244_vlg_display_element_tables with the same expected text. DISPLAY-only; the other statements that carry such a group whole are other rules.
